subject: BrightPath MAP: close-date drift, root causes and remediation path
messages:
From: Sophia Liu <sophia.liu@brightpath.health>
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com; Jake Turner <jake.turner@brightpath.health>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BrightPath MAP kickoff — potential shift to go-live

Nikhil / team,

Quick note from our side after yesterday's integration dry run. We hit two issues that push the acceptance window later unless we align on mitigations:

- Tokenization mismatch in our ETL step caused truncation for 5% of sample records (details attached).
- Procurement requires vendor sub-process sign-off tied to a new SOW item (legal says 2–3 business days).

If those are resolved this week we'll still target the end-of-month deployment; if not we should plan a one-week rebaseline.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a small hotfix for the tokenizer and whether we can fast-track the procurement paperwork?

Thanks,
Sophia
Senior PM, BrightPath Health
attachments: BrightPath_MAP_v3.pdf, redwood-eval-results-20261108.csv

From: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
To: Sophia Liu <sophia.liu@brightpath.health>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: BrightPath MAP kickoff — potential shift to go-live

Sophia — thanks for the heads-up and for sending the files. Quick read-through and initial plan below.

Short answers up front:
- Tokenization hotfix: yes, we can ship a targeted tokenizer patch that avoids truncation for the dataset schema you shared. ETA: 72 hours for a canary + validation harness.
- Procurement paperwork: we can sign the SOW addendum but need a countersign timeline from your procurement team.

Proposed near-term plan:
1) Redwood ships tokenizer patch to a canary environment by Thu 11/12 for your integration team to validate (we'll include a sanity test harness).
2) You share the procurement checklist sign-off owner + preferred DocuSign route by EOD Tue 11/10.
3) If validation is clean, we run an acceptance window on Mon 11/16 and go-live on Fri 11/20; if not clean, we meet Thu 11/12 to rebaseline.

I'll loop Marissa to coordinate the MAP updates and Sean for any SLA/backup capacity asks.

- Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: procurement_timeline.xlsx

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Sophia Liu <sophia.liu@brightpath.health>, nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: BrightPath MAP kickoff — potential shift to go-live

Thanks, Nikhil and Sophia. Short update and explicit asks so the MAP can be updated cleanly.

Summary of root causes (per integration dry run):
- Tokenization: mismatch stems from CSV pre-processing where BrightPath normalizes line breaks — our tokenizer's pre-token trimming removed trailing markers for certain rows. Impact limited but test coverage flagged it.
- Procurement: new SOW line for custom retention config requires a secondary signature from your Security Ops (per your procurement team).

Decisions / asks:
- Nikhil: please deliver the canary tokenizer build by Thu 11/12 with clear test vectors and a CLI command we can run to reproduce the fix. Include expected logs and a short rollback note.
- Sophia / Jake: please confirm the Security Ops approver contact and whether DocuSign is accepted by Tue 11/10 EOD. If DocuSign is not possible, identify the manual approver and timeline.
- All: if the canary fails validation on your side, we will propose a one-week rebaseline rather than a partial go-live. That gives time for an expanded test sweep.

MAP update plan: I'll update the MAP doc to add a contingency lane (one-week buffer) and tag the SLO checkpoint for 11/16. Expect a new MAP version v3.1 in Drive by EOD 11/12.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Sophia Liu <sophia.liu@brightpath.health>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 17:03:00 -08:00
Subject: BrightPath MAP: escalation note and approved contingency

Sophia / Jake — looping in the exec cadence briefly to confirm next steps and an official contingency approval.

After reviewing the validation reports and the canary output from Nikhil, the technical fix looks sound but we accept there is residual risk in your end-to-end ETL sweep. To avoid a failed acceptance window on 11/16 we are approving the following contingency: a formal one-week rebaseline to 11/27 with an accelerated remediation lane.

What Redwood will commit to: 
- Priority support & observability for the one-week window (11/16–11/23) including daily syncs and a dedicated Slack channel.
- A scoped patch release plan with rollback criteria and a small capacity uplift on the Dedicated pool during your acceptance test.

What we need from BrightPath:
- Security Ops countersign on the SOW addendum no later than Wed 11/18.
- Validation sign-off against the provided test vectors by Tue 11/24 EOD.

If those two asks are confirmed we'll lock the go-live to Fri 11/27 and waive the standard late-change charge for this one-week shift. If either ask is missed, we will need a second-level procurement approval and may need to revisit credits.

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success Ops, Redwood Inference
